home_title: Your family's finances, in one place
home_intro: Track the money coming in and going out of every account, personal or shared, and see where it goes.

profile_intro: Your name is shown in your account.
pwa_description: Family finances: accounts, income and expenses, in one place.
offline_text: Grand Livre needs a connection to show this page. It will reload by itself once you're back online.
install_text: Open Grand Livre in one tap from your home screen, like an app.
install_ios_title: Add Grand Livre to your home screen
install_ios_step_share: Tap the Share button, in the browser's toolbar.
install_ios_step_add: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. Don't see it? Scroll down the list.
install_ios_sign_in: Then open Grand Livre from your home screen: you'll sign in once more there, with a code we email you.
sign_in_intro_code: Enter your email: we'll send you a code to sign in, no password needed. New here? Your account is created on the way.
setup_intro: A household gathers the family's accounts. Create yours, or join one you were invited to.
household_currency_hint: Every amount of the household is in this currency.
error_household_name_required: Enter a name for the household.
error_household_name_too_long: The household's name is too long (60 characters at most).
error_household_currency_invalid: Choose a currency from the list.
error_invitation_not_found: This invitation is no longer valid.
household_intro: The name, the currency and the members of your household.
member_remove_text: They will no longer see the household's accounts. You can invite them again later.
household_leave_text: You will no longer see its accounts. An owner can invite you again.
invite_intro: Invite a member of the family by email. They join the household by signing in with that address.
